description: This file contains the server-side logic for the EditMCQ page in an online examination system. It handles events like page load, navigation button clicks (home, profile, leaderboard, logout), course selection based on semester, and session management. The code dynamically populates course lists based on selected semester and stores selected course info in session for later use.

classes.name: EditMCQ
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ASP.NET page managing MCQ editing in the online exam system.
